summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2025.0: New Library Window Welcome to the Marvelous Designer 2025.0 version new feature videos. In this video, we will introduce the newly improved library features. ## Library Window Overview The Marvelous Designer Library icon at the top right allows the library window to be turned on and off. The library window in the previous version is fixed to the left, and now it is separated alone in the new 2025 version. You can return to an earlier version of the library by clicking the arrow in the lower left corner of the new library window. By clicking the "Switch to New Library" icon at the bottom of the existing library, you can return to the new library. ## Asset Management You can browse and apply various assets more easily and quickly while managing the workspace of 3D and 2D windows. In the new library window, assets are categorized into five different groups: 1. Garment 2. Avatar 3. Fabric 4. Trim 5. Stage You can see the preview of the asset by clicking the preview icon on the top right corner of the library window. Each category has an "Assets" tab, where you can see the existing assets in Marvelous Designer, and a "Connect Asset" tab, where you can see the assets provided by Connect. ### Connect Assets Connect assets are checked in as Free by default and show free assets. You can browse the paid assets by unchecking it. Paid assets are available through the Community page, and you can check the purchased items at the Purchase tab. ## Closet Feature Access to Closet has also been added into the new library. Closet is a cloud-based platform that allows you to upload and share your 3D assets. ### Loading Assets from Closet First, I will load the project file from Closet and click on the Marvelous Designer icon in the upper left to browse for the assets you need. I'm going to look for "Oversize Shirt" and hit Apply. Reposition the shirt and press CTRL-H to strengthen it. Change the layer setting to 1 to drape the garment nicely. I will unbutton the shirt and adjust the fit a little. ## Applying Fabrics and Custom Libraries Now let's browse for the fabrics and quickly apply one for the shirt. Feel free to add in other assets from the new library. You can now create your own custom library and manage your assets effectively. You can create it by clicking the "Create New Library" button at the top. You can add assets by clicking "Add Folder." ### Saving Project Files Let's save the current project file and save it to the Custom Asset folder. I will hit the Refresh icon to see the saved project file. You could also add in other assets as you wish. ## Conclusion Okay, so that's it for this tutorial. If you have any questions, please send them in via the comment section below. I hope you have had a great time. See you in the next tutorial. Thanks for watching! Take care and have a nice day. Bye! ```
